title: Start, stop or suspend a VM
description: Control the state of a Hyper-V virtual machine: start, clean shutdown, forced shutdown, suspend or resume.

parameters.name: action
parameters.label: Action
parameters.description: Action: Start, Stop, Save, Suspend, Resume

examples.description: Save the state and suspend the VM
Pause a VM, then resume it
Example using the 'vmName' parameter: name of the virtual machine. Replace VM-WEB-01 with the value that fits your environment.

notes: Stop-VM without -Force attempts a clean shutdown through Integration Services. Save-VM frees the RAM but keeps the state. -TurnOff is the same as -Force.

fr.title: Démarrer, arrêter ou suspendre une VM

fr.notes: Stop-VM sans -Force tente un arrêt propre via Integration Services. Save-VM libère la RAM mais conserve l'état. -TurnOff équivaut à -Force.
